entities.summary: Rafael "Rafi" Menco is an Israeli professional basketball player for Hapoel HaEmek of the Israeli Basketball Premier League. He was named the Israeli Basketball Premier League Most Improved Player in 2017, and an Israeli Basketball Premier League All-Star in 2019.
